svg.aria-label: Left: boosting stumps on noisy samples of a sine curve; after 1, 10 and 100 rounds the fit goes from a single step to the curve's shape to chasing noise. Right: training and test log-loss against the number of trees for learning rates 1 and 0.1; the larger rate bottoms out early and overfits sharply, the smaller one reaches a lower minimum later
svg.text: test log-loss as trees are added
